crop: Avocado (Persea americana), grafted trees, West Cameroon highlands (Bamboutos, Menoua), 10 year horizon

bearing.text: Grafted trees bear 3 to 4 years after planting (S1, S2, S3); about 3 years on average against 8 to 10 years for seedlings (S4). Economic crop from year 6 (S5).

planting.text: 8 to 10 m between trees (S7); 9 x 9 m, 120 trees/ha (S5); about 150 to 162 trees/ha in the Trinidad model (S6). Holes 60 x 60 x 60 cm dug a month ahead, 20 kg farmyard manure and 120 g double superphosphate each (S5). Mounds 30 cm high, 1 m base; varieties alternated by row (S3). Grafted plants 1,000 to 2,000 FCFA (S8) and 3 USD in a 2022 Cameroon offer (S8).

labour_person_days_per_ha_year.harvest: 20 in year 3, 40 from year 4, about 338 kg per person day

inputs_per_ha_year.text: Contact insecticide 1 to 2 L, copper fungicide 1 kg, soil fungicide 2 kg (S6).

yields.text: More than 10 t/ha a year in a well kept orchard (S1, S2). 230 to 320 kg per tree, 7.5 to 11 t/ha; 300 to 400 kg/ha at 3 to 5 years and 800 to 1,000 kg/ha after 5 years in another table of the same sheet (S5). Trinidad model: 6.75 t/ha in year 3, 13.5 t/ha from year 4, fruit 0.45 kg, 15% post harvest loss (S6).

season.text: Two harvests in Cameroon: February to May and July to September (S1, S3).

prices.text: Traders buy a 100 kg sack at the field for 25,000 to 65,000 FCFA depending on the variety; fruits retail at 100 to 500 FCFA (S2, 2022). A sack of about 100 kg costs 10,000 to 60,000 FCFA depending on the period (S1, 2016).

markets.text: National production about 120,000 t; Bamboutos and Menoua are the main basins; sold to large cities, Europe and the Central African sub region (S1, S3). Export to the EU requires commercial varieties and certification.

confidence_notes: LOW to MEDIUM: Cameroon sources give bearing age, seasons, yield level and prices; the fertilizer schedule and labour come from Kenya (KALRO) and Trinidad. The yield ramp by age is derived. Plant prices come from producer listings.

bearing_2026_check.text: Grafted Hass trees reach maturity in 2.5 to 3 years instead of 6 to 7 (S9, 2023). Grafted trees bear after 3 to 4 years, economic crop from year 6 (S5). First fruits after about three years on average (S4).
